node.title: XR deficient window: full-affine tuple payment
node.statement: On an s-dimensional active-defect parameter hull, any fixed (s+1)-tuple of points with pairwise distinct phi=[P:Q] values belongs to a common selected block for at most 2^s target parameters. The s block equations are quadrics; affine Bezout bounds their irreducible components by 2^s, while the distinct-pole argument forces the selected ray to be constant on every positive-dimensional component and the interaction strip leaves at most one target there. For ell=1 this gives |Tau|<=2^(s-1) binom(e,s+1)/binom(r,s+1). At the next official dimensions it pays through d+1=8453534100 at rates 1/4,1/8 and through d+1=4250714177 at rate 1/16.
